context.person: A person using an invoicing service
context.user_goal: Choose a new payment method and explicitly submit the payment before the deadline.

product_state.preceding_state: Automatic payment for a business invoice failed because the saved bank account was closed.
product_state.current_state: The invoice remains unpaid. No late fee is charged until September 22.
known_facts: No late fee is charged until September 22.
A different bank account or card can be used.
Updating the payment method does not submit payment automatically.
forbidden_claims: A late fee was charged today.
Saving a new method completes payment.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: Something went wrong
current_content.body: Some details have changed. Review your account.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand invoice autopay failed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the invoice and choose a new payment method.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Review billing methods without submitting payment.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The unpaid invoice may incur a late fee after September 22.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Choose a new payment method and explicitly submit the payment before the deadline.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
